en.t: A 15% reduction in operational delays did not come from a model.
en.d: It came from counting where things stopped. I want to describe that work honestly, because it is the least glamorous thing on my CV and the one I would repeat first at almost any company. No prediction. No agent. I took the operational process data and measured how long each step actually took, versus how long everyone believed it took. Those two numbers…
